title: Angular Steering: Behavior Control via Rotation in Activation Space

summary.claim: Angular Steering rotates activations within a fixed 2D subspace, unifying vector addition and directional ablation in one geometric frame and giving smooth, fine-grained control of behavior.
summary.condition: Refusal and emotion steering across several model families and sizes; an adaptive variant rotates only activations aligned with the target direction.
summary.gap: (Inferred) How much rotation drags other behaviors (e.g., sycophancy, confidence) along is not studied.
